boards.title: Claimed by 9am: 10 Study Spots Worth Showing Up Early For
boards.description: Ten documented campus and adjacent-library environments for individual focus, group work, and technology-supported study.

cards.title: Zen Booths
cards.subtitle: Moon Library · main floor
cards.notes: Use an individual booth when you need a quieter workstation; each includes an adjustable desk and its own light system.
cards.short_summary: Private individual workstations inside ESF’s campus library.
cards.evidence_claim: SUNY ESF says Moon Library has three Zen Booths that provide individual, private, quiet workstations with adjustable desks and lights.
cards.source_title: Creating a New Sense of Space for Students
cards.access_notes: Located in Moon Library; follow current library access and community guidelines.

cards.title: Moon Library Main Floor Tables
cards.subtitle: Moon Library · main floor
cards.notes: Pull tables together for a project meeting, or take a separate seat for independent work in the library’s main-floor area.
cards.short_summary: Flexible tables for solo work or a small project group.
cards.evidence_claim: SUNY ESF states that Moon Library’s main floor has tables for group work and quiet nooks for independent work.
cards.source_title: Navigating Campus Life at SUNY ESF
cards.access_notes: Use during current Moon Library open hours; library community norms apply.

cards.title: Moon Library Lobby
cards.subtitle: Moon Library · upper level
cards.notes: Set up in the lobby when the staffed library is closed, provided your ESF ID has been activated for the 24/7 access program.
cards.short_summary: An after-hours designated study area for eligible ESF community members.
cards.evidence_claim: Moon Library’s 24/7 access program lists the upper-level Moon Lobby as an available after-hours space.
cards.access_notes: After-hours access requires active ESF student, faculty, or staff affiliation, an activated ESF ID, and use of designated areas.

cards.entity_name: Outer Academic Success Center Team Rooms
cards.title: Outer Academic Success Center Team Rooms
cards.subtitle: Moon Library · lower level
cards.notes: Plan a collaborative session in the outer ASC team rooms, which are designated within Moon’s after-hours access area.
cards.short_summary: Lower-level rooms intended for team-based work.
cards.evidence_claim: Moon Library lists the Outer Academic Success Center team rooms among its available after-hours lower-level spaces.
cards.access_notes: After-hours access requires an active ESF affiliation and activated ESF ID; remain in the designated 24/7 area.

cards.title: MOSAIC Lounge
cards.subtitle: Moon Library · lower level
cards.notes: Use the MOSAIC Lounge for a change of setting between study tasks; keep the shared after-hours environment productive for others.
cards.short_summary: A named lower-level lounge within Moon’s after-hours area.
cards.evidence_claim: Moon Library identifies the MOSAIC Lounge as an available lower-level space in its 24/7 access program.
cards.access_notes: Available after hours only to active ESF students, faculty, and staff with activated IDs; community guidelines apply.

cards.title: Moon 19 Classroom
cards.subtitle: Moon Library · lower level
cards.notes: Use Moon 19 for focused coursework when it is available; confirm any scheduled class use before settling into the room.
cards.short_summary: A named lower-level classroom included in Moon’s access plan.
cards.evidence_claim: Moon Library lists Moon 19 Classroom as an available lower-level space in its 24/7 access program.
cards.access_notes: After-hours access requires active ESF affiliation and an activated ID; availability may be affected by academic scheduling.

cards.title: Quiet Reading Room
cards.subtitle: Bird Library · lower level
cards.notes: Head to Bird’s lower-level Quiet Reading Room when you want a designated reading environment away from the library’s commons areas.
cards.short_summary: A formally identified quiet space in nearby Bird Library.
cards.evidence_claim: Syracuse University Libraries lists the Quiet Reading Room on Bird Library’s lower level.
cards.access_notes: Bird is public daily until 7 p.m.; current SU or SUNY-ESF ID holders must swipe in before 8 a.m., before 10 a.m. weekends, and after 7 p.m.

cards.entity_name: Diane and Bob Miron '59 Learning Commons
cards.title: Diane and Bob Miron ’59 Learning Commons
cards.subtitle: Bird Library · first floor
cards.notes: Choose the Learning Commons when you need computer workstations, printing access, or an open study area close to library service points.
cards.short_summary: A first-floor open-study and technology environment in Bird Library.
cards.evidence_claim: Syracuse University Libraries lists computer workstations, printing stations, and open study areas in the Diane and Bob Miron '59 Learning Commons.
cards.access_notes: Bird is public daily until 7 p.m.; a current SU or SUNY-ESF ID is required for specified early and late building access.

cards.title: Plastics Pioneers Reading Room
cards.subtitle: Bird Library · sixth floor
cards.notes: Take the elevator to the sixth floor for this named reading room, then follow Special Collections Research Center access expectations nearby.
cards.short_summary: A named sixth-floor reading room in Bird Library.
cards.evidence_claim: Syracuse University Libraries lists the Plastics Pioneers Reading Room on Bird Library’s sixth floor.
cards.access_notes: Bird is public daily until 7 p.m.; a current SU or SUNY-ESF ID is required for specified early and late building access.

cards.title: Safire Room
cards.subtitle: Bird Library · sixth floor
cards.notes: Use the Safire Room for quiet work on Bird’s sixth floor; bring only what you need and respect the room’s focused setting.
cards.short_summary: A named quiet-work room on Bird Library’s sixth floor.
cards.evidence_claim: Syracuse University Libraries identifies the Safire Room on Bird Library’s sixth floor as a space for quiet work.
cards.access_notes: Bird is public daily until 7 p.m.; a current SU or SUNY-ESF ID is required for specified early and late building access.
